title: Checkpoint: stable partition
prompt: Implement `void partition(int[] arr)`: reorder in place so values smaller than the pivot (arr's first element) come first, then the pivot itself, then everything else — preserving relative order. {5, 2, 8, 1, 9, 5} → {2, 1, 5, 8, 9, 5}. The count-then-act shape with a pivot slot is one clean solution.

tests.name: stable partition
tests.hint: Collect smaller values forward, park the pivot at the boundary, append the rest — all order-preserving.
